farmplan.err.offline: Cannot reach the farm server. What you typed is still on this phone. Please try again when you have a connection.
farmplan.err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
farmplan.fill_first: Please fill in the needed boxes first.
farmplan.expertise: This tool supports local expertise and never replaces it. Please talk to your Agriculture Instructor before you decide.
farmplan.proto: Prototype: stored but not analysed yet
farmplan.zones.title: My land and soil
farmplan.zones.lead: Your field is split into parts by how steep it is and where water gathers. Each part can need different crops.
farmplan.zones.source: Source: open terrain data (about 30 m detail) worked out by the server. These are modelled, not measured on your land. Please correct anything that does not match what you see.
farmplan.zones.recompute: Work out my land parts again
farmplan.zones.compute_help: This uses the terrain around your farm. It needs an internet connection and can take a short while.
farmplan.zones.nodem: The terrain data could not be fetched. No land parts are shown, and none are made up. Please try again later.
farmplan.zones.none: No land parts yet. Press the button above.
farmplan.zones.edit_hint: Tap a part on the map to see it and change its type if it is wrong.
farmplan.zones.edit_warn: Your change is saved as 'edited by you' and used in your plan. The first computed version stays on record.
farmplan.zones.draft: Slope limits (flat under 5%, gentle 5 to 15%, steep 15 to 30%, very steep over 30%) are draft values for an Agriculture Instructor to review.
farmplan.map.aria: Map of your field with its land parts
farmplan.map.noleaflet: The map could not be loaded.
farmplan.threat.note: Threat levels are modelled and relative (low, medium, high). They compare parts of your field, they are not a measured loss.
farmplan.threat.title: Threats to my field
farmplan.threat.none: No computed threats yet. Work out your land parts first.
farmplan.threat.erosion_note: The erosion level is a relative index (rain strength, soil, slope, cover). It is only a ranking, not tonnes of soil.
farmplan.soil.title: Soil
farmplan.soil.source: Modelled soil comes from a global soil map (coarse, about 250 m) and may be wrong for your field. What you measure or know yourself is shown separately and is used first.
farmplan.soil.nothing: Type at least one value first.
farmplan.soil.prefer: If you give a value, your value is used instead of the map value.
farmplan.plan.title: My crop plan
farmplan.plan.lead: Three ways to plan your seasons. Compare them and talk them over with your Agriculture Instructor.
farmplan.plan.disclaimer: These are suggestions from rules and open data, not promises. Rain and markets can change. Never treat a plan as certain.
farmplan.plan.needs_zones: A plan needs your land parts and farm details first. Open 'My land and soil' and work out your land parts.
farmplan.plan.empty: The server returned no plan options. There is not enough data yet.
farmplan.plan.nonestored: No plan made yet. Press 'Make my plan'.
farmplan.plan.sources: Crop facts come from the crop table of this project. Each fact has a source and an evidence level (V1 published research, V2 extension handbook, V3 traditional knowledge, V4 checked with platform data). Most values are drafts that still need expert review.
farmplan.plan.nocrops: No crop list in this answer.
farmplan.plan.risks: Risks to check with an officer
farmplan.plan.officer: Please check this plan with an Agriculture Instructor (steep land, weak evidence or low confidence).
farmplan.plan.whynot: Why some crops were left out
farmplan.opt.baseline_hint: Built from your crop history, with the rules applied.
farmplan.opt.soil_hint: Legumes and cover crops to feed the soil and hold it in place.
farmplan.opt.water_hint: Crops that need less water, for drier years.
farmplan.scn.title: What if the rain changes?
farmplan.scn.notforecast: This is a stress test using how much rain has varied in past years. It is NOT a forecast.
farmplan.scn.showing: Showing the plan for: rain {rain}, rain starts {delay}. This is a what-if, not a forecast.
farmplan.conf.unknown: Confidence: not available for this option.
farmplan.conf.high_reason: Good data and well-supported advice, checked locally. Still confirm with an officer.
farmplan.conf.medium_reason: Some data or evidence is weak or area-level only. Use with care.
farmplan.conf.low_reason: Data is thin or the advice is not checked locally. Treat as an idea to discuss, not a decision.
farmplan.conf.formula: Draft formula: 40% data quality, 30% strength of evidence, 30% local checking. High is 0.70 or more, medium 0.40 or more. These weights are drafts.
farmplan.trace.none: No rule list was returned for this option.
farmplan.trace.help: Each line is one decision the program made, so an officer can check it.
farmplan.mock.title: Notes and monitoring
farmplan.mock.lead: Keep records of your soil and your own knowledge. These screens are prototypes: your entries are saved, but nothing is calculated from them yet.
farmplan.mock.p_label: Name of the spot (for example 'near the big tree')
farmplan.mock.v_guide: Fill in what you can measure. Leave the rest empty.
farmplan.mock.v_worms: Earthworms in one spade of soil
farmplan.mock.v_infil: Minutes for a bucket of water to soak in
farmplan.mock.notrend: Values are only listed. No trend or advice is calculated yet.
farmplan.mock.pr_why: Tell us about a practice you or your family use. It is stored as 'traditional only' until research or platform data supports it.
farmplan.mock.pr_consent: I agree that this is stored and shared as I chose above.
farmplan.mock.pr_status: Status after saving: traditional only (not yet validated).
farmplan.mock.is_help: Something wrong with a crop or with the advice? Tell us. For urgent crop problems, please also see your Agriculture Instructor.
farmplan.road.title: Coming later (roadmap)
farmplan.road.note: Not built yet. These are only described here.
farmplan.road.alerts_text: Warnings for dry spells or heavy rain on your field.
farmplan.road.learning_text: Season reviews and soil visits will later check and improve the advice.
farmplan.road.officer_text: Agriculture Instructors will review plans and crop facts.
farmplan.road.village_text: Shared practices and results for a village, with each person's consent.
farmplan.mock.trend_none: Not enough data yet: a value needs at least two visits.
farmplan.plan.missing: Some inputs were not available, so the plan is less certain: {list}.
farmplan.plan.bare: no crop passes the rules (left bare)
farmplan.plan.benefits_note: Average draft rating (0 to 3) of the chosen crops from the crop table. Not a yield or income promise.
farmplan.plan.whynot_help: For the first season, these crops failed a test for at least one part of your land.
farmplan.scn.delay_note: The late-start setting is recorded with the plan but does not change the crop rules yet.
farmplan.x.why.legume_before_cereal: {crop} gets a bonus because a legume came before it (a draft rule).
farmplan.x.why.contour_hedge: {crop} is planted as a hedge along the contour on the {zone_kind} part, to slow water and hold soil.
farmplan.x.risk.marginal_fit: {crop} only just fits here. Marginal on: {tests}.
farmplan.x.risk.penalty_applied: {crop} was marked down by a rule (for example the same plant family as last season).
farmplan.x.risk.same_family_repeated: {crop} is from the same plant family ({family}) as before, so pests and disease can build up.
farmplan.x.risk.no_legume_two_seasons: No legume in two seasons in a row ({seasons}). The soil may lose nitrogen.
farmplan.x.risk.crop_conflict: A crop pairing is flagged as a conflict: {detail}
farmplan.x.risk.bare_season: No crop passed the rules for the {zone_kind} part this season, so it would be bare. Bare soil is exposed to erosion.
farmplan.x.risk.baseline_does_not_fit: {crop}, from your history, does not fit well here. Tests: {tests}.
farmplan.x.gap.crop_not_in_knowledge: {crop} is not in the crop table, so it could not be checked.
farmplan.x.gap.no_crop_history: No crop history was given, so Option 1 cannot copy what you grow now.
farmplan.x.gap.no_zone_weights: No weights for the {zone} kind of land, so default weights were used.
farmplan.x.gap.template_missing: The {template} rotation template is missing, so a simple fallback was used.
farmplan.x.gap.test_not_checked: {crop}: the {test} test could not be checked because the data is missing.
farmplan.x.confidence.computed: Confidence {score} ({class}). Draft weights 0.4 data, 0.3 evidence, 0.3 local checking. Evidence levels: {evidence_levels}.
farmplan.x.reason.no_cold_season: No cold season for corm development in the Dry Zone.
